profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Senior Test Engineer | Ex-Google | Ex-Nest
profile.summary:
Android Developer at Signos and author of Distill: An AI powered article reading and summarization tool for Android. 
Senior Software Test Engineer with 8+ years of experience leading software testing on iOS and Android, with an emphasis in real-device IOT integration testing. Experience in developing and leading team members to create end-to-end automation and UI, integration and functional testing for critical user journeys.  Proven track record of leading test planning, test design and execution at all stages of the software development life cycle.

positions.title: Senior Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Led mobile app automated testing efforts for Google Nest camera and security products. 
• Wrote automated tests in Python, Kotlin and Swift for highly touched, critical user journeys across the Android, iOS and web apps.
• Led development of Device to App latency testing infrastructure for new product initiatives resulting in all Nest products in 2022 to ship with latency testing completed.
• Delivered end-to-end device setup automation for new products. Validate firmware build success rate and mobile app pairing pairing success. 
• Delivered code contributions to larger test infrastructure utilized by development and testing teams to achieve less than 5% down time for continuous tests.
• Coordinated test planning and execution for contract team members overseas and at home.
• Mentored QA Engineers helping in their professional development and skills.

Google Home App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.chromecast.app&hl=en_US

2023- Home App Redesign and Web App
2022- Nest Doorbell Wired, Nest Camera Wired
2021 - Nest Doorbell Battery, Nest Camera Battery
2019 - Nest Hub Max

positions.title: Test Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
• Test Lead for Camera product app features on Android and iOS
• Automate end-to-end tests for our Android app using Espresso and UIAutomator frameworks.
• Coordinated test planning and execution for team of four.
• Architected test plans, test cases and test design specifications at all stages of the software development life cycle for Nest's Camera Product suite in our mobile apps. 
• Collaborated with project management and engineering teams to routinely review and refine test plans and strategies.
• Testing consisted of Black Box, functional, integration / system testing, and automation.
• Leveraged test management tools (TestFlight and TestRail) for organizing test cases, test runs, and results. 


The Nest App: https://youtu.be/Wh5hk1QdkBQ
positions.insights: Android UiAutomator, Test Strategy and +11 skills

positions.title: Product Quality Analyst
positions.description: Investigated root causes that drove technical and non-technical support questions. Gathered extensive documentation surrounding circumstances that lead to the customer's need for support. This data was then shared with Nest teams for improving reliability and usability across products.
